units: <cite ref="Chullin 47b">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ בריאה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אָטוּם</he>) an obstruction in the lungs, a spot imperviable to air when blown up. Ohol. VI, 5 we regard the levitical uncleanness between the rafters <he>כאילו הוא א׳</he> as if it was locked up (and could not affect what is in the house).
